_comment: The coaching staff's game-by-game performance goals: the numbers, and only
the numbers. This is the file to edit when a target changes - nothing else
in the pipeline carries one. A change here republishes every match's goals
on the next scrape, and pushing it triggers one immediately.
What you can change: a target, the order goals appear in, how many decimals
a number is written to, and whether a goal is a floor or a ceiling. You can
add or remove a whole goal. What you cannot change here is how a number is
calculated: 'metric' names a formula in update-seed.py, and a goal naming a
metric that does not exist stops the run rather than quietly disappearing.
ceiling: true means the target is a maximum - at or below it counts as met.
Only errors per set and the opponent's hitting percentage work that way.
A goal with no number behind it in a given match is not counted as won or
lost: the ace-to-error ratio in a match with no service errors, or a role
nobody filled, leaves both halves of the fraction rather than scoring as a
free pass.
The tracker's two serve-receive rows are deliberately absent. A 0-3 passing
grade is charted by the staff and published in no box score, so there is
nothing here to evaluate them from.
Known problem, left as the staff set it: Digs/set at 15.5 has been met in
none of the ten 2026 matches, and the best night was 15.00. It also punishes
winning quickly - the two 3-0s sit lowest on it because the opponent swung
far less. Digs/opp attack measures the same defence against the work it was
given; its .400 is not a translation of the 15.5 but a number set where the
rest of this sheet sits, met five times in ten this season.
